reader.requirement: At 85 every execution of CLOSE on an indexed file, successful or not, in every access mode and with or without LOCK, stores a fresh I-O status in the FILE STATUS item ('00' success, '42' not open, '30' permanent error), replacing the previous statement's value.

the same behavior, the OPEN-side test of that lock ('38')
